## Description

Queries the Korean Statistical Information Service (`통계청 KOSIS`, `국가통계포털`) Open API for national statistics — population, price indices, macroeconomic indicators, and other government-published statistical tables. Covers keyword search, table-list browsing, statistical data retrieval, and metadata lookup. Requires KOSIS_API_KEY environment variable.
